probes.description: A concept declared system:true gets no generated REST route (no menu, export, agent tool or catalog entry either). SystemVaultProbe is system:true, so GET /api/system_vault_probes is not served; the control reads an ordinary concept the same way and is served (200), and ConversionDemoProduct (same shape, not system) has the route /api/conversion_demo_products, which fixes the naming rule the first request relies on.

steps.name: system concept list is not served
control: an ordinary concept is served
